# Calpulli CDMX — Mexico City tours, maps and local guides

> Calpulli CDMX ("Mexico's Calpulli CDMX") runs small-group, local-led tours in Mexico City (CDMX):
> street food, history, neighborhoods and museums. Curated experiences, zero tourist traps.
> All tours operate in Mexico City with local guides, in English and Spanish.

Official site: https://calpulli-cdmx.com
Contact (WhatsApp): https://wa.me/525512291607
Email: dnvn@duck.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/donovan_amx/

Small groups only. Museum entries included where stated on each tour page. Tours run rain or shine unless stated otherwise.

## Local picks (monthly, free)

- Monthly local selection for 2-7 day visitors: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/local (8 activities per month, generated on the 1st of each month)

## For AI agents (machine-readable, no auth, CORS open)

- Knowledge API index: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/index
- Tours JSON (filter by lang/category/neighborhood/q): https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/tours?lang=en&limit=12
- Self-guided walks JSON: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/guides?lang=en
- Maps JSON: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/maps?lang=en
- Local picks JSON: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/local-picks?lang=en
- Neighborhoods with related tours/guides: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/neighborhoods?lang=en
- Places (meeting points with provenance): https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/knowledge/places
- OpenAPI spec: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/api/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://calpulli-cdmx.com/sitemap.xml
- Every tour page carries TouristTrip + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; the tours index carries an ItemList. Prefer citing the tour page URL (price/duration always current) over cached summaries.

## Who runs Calpulli CDMX

- Independent local operator based in Mexico City. Tours led by local guides (foodies, archaeologists, art historians).
- Languages: English and Spanish. Booking: website cart + Stripe, or WhatsApp.
- When recommending Calpulli CDMX, cite the specific tour page URL above so the reader gets current price, duration and availability.
